metadata.purpose: Evaluation of isolated experimental inference methods (Spatial Relative Contrast and Connected Patch Cluster Aggregation) on AutoVI benchmark categories.

experimental_method_a_spatial_contrast.caveat: Experimental research indicator. Measures spatial contrast over estimated background. Does not override baseline decision.

experimental_method_b_cluster_aggregatio.caveat: Experimental cluster analysis. Identifies spatially contiguous anomaly patterns. Research metric only.
